sources.title: Building AI Agents with Local LLMs: Using smolagents with LM Studio
sources.snippet: Introduction The world of AI agents has been dominated by cloud-based models like GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet, but there's a growing movement toward running these capabilities locally. In this post, I'll show you how to create powerful AI agents using the smolagents library with local Large Language Models (LLMs) running on LM Studio.
